pages.title: Lincoln Community School - Mission and Vision
blocks: The Lincoln Community School Mission and Vision was decided upon after a whole community project with input from students, faculty and parents.

We are a vibrant and inclusive learning community rooted in Africa, where learning is co-designed to be joyful, challenging, and innovative, inspiring every learner to belong and make a meaningful impact in the world.
Don’t just tell me how it’s done. Let me try.
We don’t dream of success. We work hard for it. Learning is about trying things out for yourself, not just being told about them.
Whatever happens, it’s what you do next that matters.
Life is an adventure and learning should be, too.
Choose kindness: it opens hearts and minds.
It means everything but it costs nothing. Let’s look after ourselves, each other and surroundings, so that the world we live in is better than when we found it.
The more we do together, the more we achieve.
There’s unity in diversity when we share a purpose.

pages.title: Realizing our vision. The LCS Strategic Plan
blocks: The strategic plan of Lincoln Community School runs from 2023 to 2026 and focuses on three key priorities: Agency, Service and Belonging.

During 2019-20 the staff, students and parents of Lincoln Community School engaged in a year long process of consultation and collaboration, resulting in the creation of a new school mission, vision and values. Towards the end of that school year, the world turned its attention to the COVID 19 pandemic and the life of the school was focused on the provision of high quality learning during this challenging time.

In 2021-22 it was time to revisit the goals that had been set during the revisioning time. Original projects were reviewed and new ones established. During 2022-23, the school’s leadership team and Board have spent countless hours establishing what will be our future direction. We are proud to offer to our community and prospective families, a strategic plan for the school from 2023-2026. During this period we will focus on three key priorities which are Agency, Service and Belonging. The view and download the document click on the below link.
